reason: The only candidate, Pieter Schalk Joubert of Uitenhage, carries the name of this man's recorded father. No owner is named Christoffel Johannes.

No Uitenhage Van Rooyen owner is named Dirk. The candidates are Gerrit, Cornelis Johannes, Gerrit Rynier and Martinus, which are clearly different given names.

C01 Nicolaas Johannes Basson of Uitenhage matches the first two given names and the district. Omitting the third name Salomon is normal.
